settings.story: At Cake Junction, we believe every milestone celebration deserves a masterpiece. Handcrafted fresh from scratch with pure dairy butter, pure Belgian couverture, and real fruit compotes, our artisanal cakes transform birthdays, weddings, and anniversaries into unforgettable memories.
settings.bakerBio: Trained in French pâtisserie and classical confectionery, Chef Ananya infuses Indian botanical flavors like cardamom, saffron, and damask rose into contemporary Swiss buttercream tiers.
settings.heroHeadline: Beautiful Cakes, Baked for Your Special Moments.
settings.heroSubheadline: Handcrafted celebration cakes, bespoke wedding tiers, and daily fresh bakes made to order with organic butter and pure Belgian couverture.

settings.deliveryAreas: Complimentary pickup from atelier. Doorstep temperature-controlled delivery available across city limits.
settings.pickupInstructions: Please present your order reference number during pickup window between 11 AM - 7 PM.
settings.deliveryTerms: Custom tiered cakes are delivered by dedicated chilled bakery vehicles. Orders must be placed at least 48 hours in advance.
settings.cancellationPolicy: Due to the custom nature of perishable baked goods, cancellations requested >48 hours prior to fulfilment receive 80% store credit or refund. Within 48 hours of celebration, orders cannot be cancelled once baking has commenced.
settings.privacyPolicy: We collect only your contact number and celebration preferences solely to fulfil your cake order. We never sell or share your personal data with third-party advertisers.
settings.termsOfService: Cake designs are handcrafted artisanal interpretations. Color tones and hand-piped flowers may exhibit subtle natural variations.
settings.invoiceTerms:
1. Perishable confectionery crafted fresh to custom specification; payments non-refundable once production commences.
2. In the event of transit delay caused by force majeure, Cake Junction will communicate promptly.
3. All disputes subject to Chennai jurisdiction.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I place my custom cake order?
faqs.answer: For standard celebration cakes, we require a minimum of 48 hours advance notice. For multi-tiered wedding cakes and sculpted custom designs, we recommend reserving your date 1 to 2 weeks in advance.

faqs.question: Are eggless options available for all flavours?
faqs.answer: Yes! Over 90% of our signature flavours can be baked 100% eggless using organic condensed dairy and flax-emulsion methods without compromising moisture or crumb softness.

faqs.question: How are multi-tiered celebration cakes transported?
faqs.answer: We utilize dedicated climate-controlled, air-conditioned delivery vans with custom non-slip silicone bases to ensure your cake arrives in pristine, gallery-worthy condition.

faqs.question: How does payment work for custom quotes?
faqs.answer: Once our head baker approves your design and date, we request a 50% advance deposit via direct UPI QR payment to confirm your baking slot. The remaining balance is payable prior to handover.
